generation_jobs.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Wide 16:9 cinematic website hero artwork. One continuous scene, no typography.

[FOCAL SUBJECT]
One lightweight abstract access sculpture, positioned on the right third at roughly 69 percent of frame width, occupying approximately 34 percent of the image width. Exactly two thin upright complementary panels, taller than wide, with clearly slim side edges. Their mating seam has exactly one shallow horizontal offset slightly above the midpoint. Closed state: a fine but clearly visible seam. The full silhouette fits inside x=49–87%, y=13–88%, with outer room for later horizontal opening. A metaphor for software access, not a physical electronic product.

[COMPOSITION]
Both panels stand on one continuous deep graphite studio floor, no pedestal, with a grounded soft contact shadow. Camera in a restrained three-quarter view. Strong horizontal depth. The leftward environment continues naturally into subdued tonal depth for native website copy; it remains the same textured studio, never a separate empty band. No extra foreground objects.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Quiet architectural still life, precise geometric staging, sculptural light, restrained dramatic depth. Clean air without smoke or particles. Lightweight surfaces and fine edges rather than a massive monolith.

[LIGHTING]
A large gridded stripbox at 45 degrees upper camera-left, 5200K neutral light. Narrow neutral rear-right rim. Deep shadow side with selective fill, gentle grounded contact shadows. Controlled grazing edge highlights; subtle tonal separation from the environment.

[LENS & CAMERA]
50mm, f/8, camera slightly above panel center, restrained three-quarter angle. Deep focus over both panels, parallel upright edges, no wide-angle distortion.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Satin graphite faces with extremely fine vertical brushing. Neutral titanium edge highlights. Restrained violet reflection only on inward-facing seam edges. Near-black graphite environment with visible shadow detail. No overall violet wash.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
Geometric minimal still-life discipline, deliberate sculptural composition, classical museum-like staging and controlled dramatic editorial light. Physically grounded, tactile brushed material, coherent environment.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Tack-sharp commercial surface detail, editorial commercial standard, ultra-realistic textures and materials, readable asymmetrical seam at small size, crisp thin edges.

[AVOID]
No text, labels, numbers, logo, watermark, signatures, fake words or embedded UI. No AI artifacts, plastic look, waxy surfaces, cartoon rendering, melted geometry, doubled subjects, extra panel parts, additional seams, chunky slabs, heavy machinery or pedestal. No circular portal, ring, orb, spaceship, doorframe, server appliance, ports, screws, cables, coins, banknotes, crypto symbols or holographic interface. No people, limbs, smoke, particles, lens flare, oversaturated HDR, halos, oversharpening, flat fluorescent light, on-camera flash, invisible black edges or clipped highlights. No stale stock aesthetic, generic staging, clipart, artificial empty rectangles, disconnected color bands, dull pasted gradients or composited-looking backgrounds. The calm left area remains part of the same continuous environment.

resolution: 2k

A six-second silent architectural product film from the supplied image. One completely locked camera. Preserve the exact original two thin upright brushed graphite panels, their complementary single shallow offset cuts, lighting, floor, material and all background details.

At 0–0.4 seconds, hold the original image still. At 0.4–2.2 seconds, SLIDE BOTH RIGID PANELS HORIZONTALLY APART a very small distance: left panel translates left by about 3 percent of the full frame width and right panel translates right by the same amount. Their scale, height, angle, shape and depth never change. Create a narrow physically empty dark opening between the complementary cuts. Keep the complete paired object within the right half of the image. The floor-contact shadows follow the subtle translations naturally. At 2.2–6 seconds, hold the resulting open state perfectly still.

The gate is a restrained metaphor for paid software access. Neutral 5200K upper-left soft gridded studio key, tactile satin brushing, narrow titanium edge highlights, very restrained violet only on the inward-facing edges. No additional light source. Same camera perspective, focus and exposure throughout.

No camera movement, zoom, dolly, orbit, camera shake, rotation, depth movement, bending, morphing, thickening, scaling, dissolving, extra seams, new objects, wide opening, doors swinging, particles, text, interface, coins, fog, flares, flicker, exposure shift or audio. One gentle physical translation only, then a static hold. Do not close or reverse.

model_note: Image submissions requested nano_banana_pro. The completion API labels them nano_banana_2; the provider alias relationship was not independently verified. No automatic model substitution was requested.

processing.film: Take the first 3 seconds of the generated 6.042-second film, retime to 2.2 seconds, then hold its last frame through 6 seconds. Silent H.264, 1600x892, 24 fps, CRF22, faststart. No further generation.
processing.posters: Extracted from the edited film at 0 and 5.9 seconds, encoded WebP quality88.
